The right side has an orange-tan wall that widens from about 2 px to about 8 px over rows 6-63. Rows 64-79 are flat dirt ground with grass at the corners. There are no front-edge lines, eave shadows or ellipses, so the ramp is a continuous sloped surface seen with the side walls converging. The column scan shows texture noise (L about 110-140) with no band structure. It reads as a ramp with receding side walls rather than a standing object with a top and a front face, so none of the standard classes fit cleanly.
